FAsymmetricCutoff.integral_limit.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (d : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hd : MeasureTheory.Integrable d mu) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun p =>
      ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
        FAsymmetricCutoff.mask K p.1.1 p.1.2 (LCutoffRegime.sharedSmoothing p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2) x * d x ∂mu)
    LCutoffRegime.localRegime (nhds (∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), d x ∂mu))
